updates.title: Rebuilt Screenshot Tool as a persistent capture service
updates.summary: Replaced per-hotkey application startup with a persistent GTK4 service, then added precise frozen-region selection and exact identity matching for same-titled windows.
updates.previewAlt: Screenshot Tool frozen-region selector with live dimensions, keyboard guidance, crosshairs, and a magnified pointer view

updates.title: Renamed images with local vision models
updates.summary: Created a batch command that asked a local Ollama vision model for short descriptive filenames and copied each result without altering the originals.
updates.previewAlt: Renamed images with local vision models

updates.title: Added a keyboard toggle for the OBS virtual camera
updates.summary: Created a keyboard shortcut that started RVM background removal, launched OBS minimized with its virtual camera active, and stopped both processes on the next press.
updates.previewAlt: Added a keyboard toggle for the OBS virtual camera

related.title: Built a real-time webcam background removal pipeline
related.summary: Built a real-time webcam pipeline that used Robust Video Matting to separate the foreground, replace or blur the background, and expose the result as a standard V4L2 camera.

updates.title: Added screen freeze controls to Wayfire
updates.summary: Built a Wayfire plugin that captures the final compositor frame into a GPU texture and presents it—or solid black—until an IPC unfreeze request.
updates.previewAlt: Added screen freeze controls to Wayfire

updates.title: Built a clickable desktop layer for Wayland
updates.summary: Built a transparent GTK3 layer-shell surface that makes the Wayland desktop clickable, clears application focus, and opens a configurable command menu at the pointer.

updates.title: Built a modular desktop settings hub
updates.summary: Built a GTK4 control center that discovers built-in and package settings, renders them in one adaptive interface, and writes changes through their existing backends.
updates.previewAlt: Settings Hub GPU page with sidebar navigation, VRAM and temperature gauges, and utilization history

related.title: Built a desktop service manager with live logs
related.summary: Built a GTK dashboard for opted-in systemd user services, with cached live status, lifecycle controls, and a filterable shared journal stream.

updates.title: Built a local-first diagramming tool
updates.summary: Built a local-first visual editor where the browser and MCP tools work on the same JSON-backed diagram through one API and update the canvas in real time.
updates.previewAlt: Reconstructed early Diagram Tool interface zoomed out with Core API selected and its node properties open

updates.title: Built a shared history database for system activity
updates.summary: Built a PostgreSQL history store for tool operations and artifacts, with a normalized SQLAlchemy schema, repository API, and provenance queries.
updates.previewAlt: The first recorded Systems History Database output and its linked artifacts
